observation.most_important: Clear consequences stated (transcription will also be deleted); two clear action buttons
observation.next_action: Confirm deletion ('捨てる') or cancel ('やめる')
anomalies: Text '削除せよう' is grammatically awkward/archaic Japanese — unusually formal command form for UI confirmation
Redundant messaging: heading says '削除せよう' + warning text, then button says '捨てる' — two similar concepts using different verbs
Dark red background is heavy-handed for a simple confirmation action

ai_look: redundant messaging using two similar verbs (削除/捨てる)
over-aggressive styling (dark red background) for simple confirmation
E11E.why: The unnatural Japanese text is a concrete defect. '削除せよう' reads archaic/overly formal and doesn't match modern app localization. Redundancy (title + button both express deletion) adds confusion. Dark red background treating this as high-stakes when it's a standard reversal action. The combination of poor localization, messaging redundancy, and over-emphasized styling indicates a gap in craftsmanship.
